name: marlo-mcp
description: Audit a web page for SEO and technical issues with Marlo, the open-source AI CMO. Read-only.
long_description: Ask your assistant to audit a page and get the top issues with evidence, why each matters and a concrete fix. Read-only: it fetches the page and changes nothing. It checks one page and shows the top three findings. By default it uses the hosted Marlo; point it at your own self-hosted Marlo with the optional settings.

tools.name: audit_site
tools.description: Audit one public web page and return its top SEO and technical issues with evidence and a fix. Read-only.

base_url.title: Your Marlo server (optional)
base_url.description: Leave empty to use the hosted Marlo at https://app.marlo.mlforge.in. Set it to your own self-hosted Marlo, for example http://localhost:3000.

access_password.title: Your server's access password (optional)
access_password.description: Only if you set MARLO_ACCESS_PASSWORD on your own server. It is sent only to the server address above, never to the hosted Marlo.
